title: Bernoulli restriction probability is at most one
statement: Fix $n$ and a real parameter $p$ with $0 \le p \le 1$. Then for every decidable predicate on restrictions of $n$ variables, the probability that it holds under a Bernoulli($p$) random restriction is at most $1$.
hypotheses_covered: an arbitrary decidable event/predicate on restrictions of $n$ variables
replaced:
If $0 \le p \le 1$, then for every (decidable) event the Bernoulli probability
$\mathrm{bernoulliRestrProb}(p,\mathrm{event})$ is at most $1$.
